description: This Java source file defines the X509AuthHandler class, responsible for authenticating MQTT clients via X.509 certificates within the Eclipse Hono project. The class extends ExecutionContextAuthHandler, parses credentials from the SSL/TLS peer certificates, and integrates with the authentication provider.

classes.name: X509AuthHandler
classes.description: A handler for authenticating an MQTT client using an X.509 client certificate, extending ExecutionContextAuthHandler for MQTT context within the Hono framework.

methods.name: X509AuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with the client authentication service and authentication provider.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Parses and validates the client's X.509 certificate from the MQTT context to produce authentication credentials.
